scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; if echo "$npm_config_user_agent" | grep -q "^pnpm/"; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$npm_execpath" | grep -qi "pnpm"; then exit 0; fi; echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
